It flows into the East China Sea near Shanghai. The Yellow River is the second longest in China.
When did President Ayub Khan resign?
Ayub Khan resigned on 25 March 1969 and handed power to General Yahya Khan.
Mass protests in 1968-69 led to his resignation.
Under whose rule was the 1962 Constitution of Pakistan introduced?
The 1962 Constitution was enforced by President Muhammad Ayub Khan.
It introduced a presidential system and Basic Democracies.
Which country is commonly said to have been the first to recognize Pakistan?
Iran is commonly cited as the first country to recognise Pakistan.
Pakistan became independent on 14 August 1947. Sources differ on exact recognition date. Note: Duplicate of the earlier 'first to recognise Pakistan' topic; commonly cited answer, sources vary.
Who was the second Governor General of Pakistan?
Ghulam Muhammad dismissed him as PM in 1953.
Who was the last Governor-General of Pakistan?
Iskander Mirza was the last Governor-General and became the first President in March 1956.
Pakistan had four Governors-General: Jinnah, Nazimuddin, Ghulam Muhammad and Iskander Mirza.
Amiruddin Kidwai designed Pakistan's national flag.
The flag was adopted on 11 August 1947. The white stripe stands for minorities.
In a class of 500 students, 320 are present. What percentage is absent?
Where is the headquarters of the International Monetary Fund (IMF)?
The IMF headquarters is in Washington DC, USA.
The IMF was set up in 1944 (Bretton Woods) and began work in 1945.
Who won the 2022 ICC Men's T20 World Cup?
England beat Pakistan in the final at Melbourne in November 2022.
Pakistan won the T20 World Cup in 2009.
The Arabian Sea is located in which part of Pakistan?
Pakistan's coastline on the Arabian Sea lies in the south (Sindh and Balochistan).
Karachi and Gwadar are major ports.
Percentage means per hundred. 90% of 90 = 0.9 x 90.
A train's speed is twice that of a car. If the car covers 60 km in one hour, how much distance will the train cover in 30 minutes?
Train speed = 120 km/h. In half an hour it covers 120 / 2 = 60 km.
Where is the headquarters of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)?
The OIC General Secretariat is in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
The OIC was founded in 1969 at the Rabat Islamic Summit.
A man walks towards North, then turns left, then turns right. What is his present direction?
North, left = West, right = North. The two opposite turns cancel.
Left then right (or right then left) brings you back to your first direction.
Which is the hottest planet in the solar system?
Venus has a thick CO2 atmosphere causing a runaway greenhouse effect, with about 465 C surface temperature.
Mercury is the closest to the Sun but cooler than Venus.
Which is the highest peak of Balochistan?
Zarghun Ghar (about 3,578 m) near Quetta is the highest point of Balochistan.
Takht-e-Sulaiman is the highest peak of the Sulaiman Range.
Which is the largest hot desert in the world?
The Sahara in North Africa is the largest hot desert.
Antarctica is the largest desert overall. Note: Plain 'largest desert' is ambiguous (Antarctica is bigger); Sahara is the standard exam answer for hot desert.
After independence, Pakistan was run under which law as an interim constitution?
The Government of India Act 1935, with changes, worked as Pakistan's interim constitution until 1956.
The first constitution came into force on 23 March 1956.
How many member countries are in the European Union (EU)?
The EU has 27 members after the UK left in 2020.
The EU headquarters is Brussels, Belgium. The Maastricht Treaty took effect in 1993.
Mohenjo-daro is located in which district of Sindh?
Mohenjo-daro is in Larkana district, on the Indus River.
It is a UNESCO World Heritage site (1980).
Which is the largest freshwater lake of Pakistan?
Manchar Lake in Jamshoro district, Sindh, is the largest freshwater lake of Pakistan.
Keenjhar Lake in Thatta supplies water to Karachi.
On which date is Youm-e-Takbeer observed in Pakistan?
Youm-e-Takbeer marks Pakistan's nuclear tests of 28 May 1998.
The tests were conducted in the Ras Koh Hills, Chagai, Balochistan.
Mian Muhammad Bakhsh, author of "Saif-ul-Malook", was a poet of which language?
Mian Muhammad Bakhsh (1830-1907) wrote Saif-ul-Malook in Punjabi.
His shrine is at Khari Sharif near Mirpur, AJK.
Which is the smallest surah of the Holy Quran?
Al-Kawthar (Surah 108) has only 3 verses and about 10 words.
Al-Baqarah is the longest surah. Al-Asr and An-Nasr also have 3 verses but are longer.
Who signed the Tashkent Declaration (1966) for India?
Prime Minister Shastri signed it with Ayub Khan on 10 January 1966 and died in Tashkent the next day.
The Soviet Union hosted the talks.
Insulin is used to treat which disease?
Insulin controls blood sugar, so it is used for diabetes.
Insulin is made by the pancreas.
Who was the third Governor-General of Pakistan?
Ghulam Muhammad was Governor-General from October 1951 to October 1955.
He dissolved the first Constituent Assembly in 1954.
Who was President when Pakistan's 1956 Constitution came into force?
Iskander Mirza became the first President when the 1956 Constitution came into force.
Pakistan became a republic on 23 March 1956. The constitution was abrogated in 1958.
In which year was the Pakistan Peoples Party founded?
The PPP was founded on 30 November 1967 in Lahore.
The PPP won most West Pakistan seats in the 1970 election.
What is the capital of Gilgit-Baltistan?
Gilgit is the capital of Gilgit-Baltistan.
K2 lies in Gilgit-Baltistan. It was given provincial-like status in 2009.
HTTP is the protocol used to send web pages over the internet.
HTTPS is the secure version of HTTP.
Who wrote "The pen is mightier than the sword"?
English writer Edward Bulwer-Lytton wrote this line in his play "Richelieu" (1839).
The line means words and ideas are stronger than force.
On which date did General Zia-ul-Haq die in a plane crash?
Zia's C-130 crashed near Bahawalpur on 17 August 1988.
Ghulam Ishaq Khan then became acting President.
Which pass connects Parachinar with Afghanistan?
Parachinar lies in the Kurram valley, which leads to Afghanistan via the Kurram (Peiwar Kotal) route.
The Khyber Pass connects Peshawar with Jalalabad. Bolan is near Quetta.
The shrine of Shah Rukn-e-Alam is in which city?
Shah Rukn-e-Alam's tomb is in Multan and is a Tughlaq-era monument.
Multan is called the City of Saints. Baba Farid's shrine is in Pakpattan.
Who led the civil rights movement in the USA and gave the "I Have a Dream" speech?
Martin Luther King Jr. gave the "I Have a Dream" speech in 1963.
He won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1964.
What is the capital of Azad Kashmir?
Muzaffarabad is the capital of Azad Jammu and Kashmir.
Gilgit-Baltistan's capital is Gilgit. Mirpur is where Mangla Dam is.
